platform.name: iOS / iPadOS SwiftUI
platform.nativeUnits: All geometry in DESIGN.md is native logical points; component HTML/CSS previews use the same numeric CSS px values as an illustrative translation, not physical CSS pt.
platform.previewBoundary: Static component previews preserve extracted color and geometry. They do not reproduce Dynamic Type, SF Symbols, Apple semantic colors, native navigation, hit testing or SwiftUI lifecycle behavior. No web hover/focus states are invented.
platform.colorBoundary: Existing color metadata is retained. SwiftUI source and Apple semantic colors remain authoritative; this scoped workspace merge does not restore missing frontmatter tokens or synthesize tonal ramps.
platform.runtimeBoundary: Current validation uses iOS 27 / iPadOS 27; App and recorder explicitly prefer light. Deployment settings remain separate from validation coverage.

gestureBoundary.inputArea: When not focused, transparent overlay handles tap to focus and VoiceHoldGesture. When focused, native text selection remains available.
gestureBoundary.holdRecognition: LongPressGesture(minimumDuration:0.35, maximumDistance:45).sequenced(before:DragGesture(minimumDistance:0)); starts capture only in .second(true, drag).
gestureBoundary.sendButton: Outside the input hold overlay; no VoiceHoldGesture on the entire HStack.
gestureBoundary.microphoneButton: Separate tap to begin / tap again to send, with its own hold gesture.

voice-composer.compactVariant: Dashboard and customer dock use compact:true, 14pt scaled text, no separate microphone button; long press input remains available. Send glyph is 34×34pt with 11pt radius inside a 44×44pt hit area.

navigation.nativeTypes: TabView, NavigationStack, anchored popover, fullScreenCover; CompanionTabs solid in-page segments
navigation.nativeTabPlacement: iPhone bottom / iPad top in reviewed simulator captures; platform-owned
navigation.chatPresentation: Native NavigationStack push to an independent CustomerConversationPage with root tab bar hidden; back restores dashboard. Workspace selection remains in the composer dock.
navigation.readonlyRecordingKeyboard: Recording detail ignores bottom keyboard safe-area changes from modal chooser so shared metadata remains stable.

preparation-card.paging: 165pt TabView below Dynamic Type xLarge; natural card height in outer dashboard scroll at xLarge and above; no inner vertical card scroll or automatic paging.

workspace-dock.position: Below composer; left folder/name/chevron selector, right recap; flat controls, not equal-width quick actions.
workspace-dock.recap: 12pt semibold; minHeight:44; horizontalPadding:12; cornerRadius:12; Warm.lavender.opacity(0.65) background and Warm.purple foreground.
workspace-dock.accessibility: Stack controls vertically at accessibility Dynamic Type sizes.
workspace-dock.assignment: Global recordings retain multiple tags. Explicit primary-customer confirmation controls counts and customer-thread recap; no matching recording opens device guide.
workspace-dock.chooser: Anchored native popover; result list height min(224,max(104,matchCount*56 + pagination44)); popover ignores bottom keyboard safe area. Recording assignment chooser anchors to the choose-customer button and presents above it.

narrative.overview:
本文件记录已批准的 Warm 原生实现，沿用已有 Warm 配色、系统圆角字体和紫色双气泡 Mascot。少量信息、清楚的正文层级、浅色圆角容器与原生控件构成持续的沟通界面；页面策略以 `PRODUCT.md` 与 `docs/workspace-ui/BRIEF.md` 为准。

应用主体、会议录音全屏页与连续语音页均使用 Warm 浅色世界。深度主要通过色面、留白与轻描边表达，导航、安全区、sheet、系统材料和 SF Symbols 由平台提供。独立客户对话使用原生 push/back；准备包切换与语音状态变化尊重 Reduce Motion。
keyCharacteristics: 米白页面、近白内容、淡紫准备色面、紫色交互与暖橙主要动作。
系统圆角语义文字、原生三目的地和可访问的安全区布局。
独立客户对话、清晰的原文时间戳与可追溯依据。

rules.name: The Light Surface Rule
rules.body: 主体、录音全屏与连续语音共享浅色 Warm 世界；系统深色设置不切换当前 App 的色彩方案。

dos: Do 沿用 Warm 源码配色、系统圆角文字和 SF Symbols。
Do 为主体、全屏录音与连续语音保留浅色 scheme。
Do 保留原生导航、安全区、Dynamic Type 与 Reduce Motion 降级。
Do 用文字与图标共同表达状态，保留原文、待确认、依据已更新与示例标记。
donts: Don't 新增字体或替换现有 Mascot 来改变已固定的视觉体系。
Don't 把旧项目页面、四 tab 或深色录音记录作为新表面的依据。
Don't 把系统动态字体、语义颜色或原生导航伪装成固定网页 token。
Don't 用示例截图推断真实数据、外部发送、ASR 或硬件已经通过验收。
